# Seenn

> Seenn is an AI accounts-receivable agent for small and mid-sized businesses. Its AI coworker, Jess, contacts overdue clients by phone, WhatsApp, SMS, and email, follows your payment rules, handles disputes, records outcomes, and gets you paid faster — without adding staff. Serving the United States and Israel. Hebrew site at /he/.

Seenn is an approved Meta Tech Provider for WhatsApp Business. Getting started takes minutes: export your receivables from any ERP or accounting system, connect a phone/WhatsApp number, set your collection rules and escalation timing, and Jess starts contacting overdue clients automatically. Every interaction is logged to your dashboard.

## Product
- [Seenn — AI Accounts Receivable Agent (home)](https://www.seenn.ai/): what Seenn is and how the AI agent Jess collects overdue invoices automatically

- Pricing: custom plans built around your receivables volume — request a demo from any page

## Key facts
- Product: AI accounts-receivable / collections agent (the AI agent is named Jess)
- Channels: phone (natural voice), WhatsApp, SMS, email
- Capabilities: automated reminders, payment links, dispute handling, outcome logging, custom escalation rules
- Integrations: connects with ERP and accounting systems (e.g. Priority, SAP, Hashavshevet)
- Markets: United States, Israel
- Languages: English (https://www.seenn.ai/), Hebrew (https://www.seenn.ai/he/)
- Contact: hello@seenn.ai
